rules.requirement: Present services around member goals and understandable tasks.
rules.benefit: Reduces cognitive load and improves completion.

rules.evaluator_action: Attempt representative goal tasks and record comprehension/blockers.

rules.requirement: Make service ownership, contact/help, and feedback routes discoverable.
